context: Evaluates correct branch taxonomy, upstream sync, and isolation practices for feature branches.

checklist.name: Branch naming convention
checklist.description: Uses lowercase kebab-case prefixed with feat/ (e.g., feat/apple-pay-checkout).

checklist.name: Remote synchronization
checklist.description: Explicitly fetches latest remote tracking refs (git fetch origin) before branching from origin/main.

checklist.name: Integration hygiene
checklist.description: Recommends rebasing over reverse merge commits to maintain linear project history.
